verdicts.reason: A separates the green circle from the can and leaves it as a stray blob in the bottom-left. The CTA has shrunk into a tiny pill jammed against the badges, which wrap onto a second row. Body copy is too small to read, the brand mark sits under the headline, and a large dead zone is left at the top. B keeps the can centered in its circle, with the brand then the headline as in the original, so it reads as the same design. Its flaws: the headline is set off-center to the right, the CTA is shrunk to the same size as the badges so it no longer stands out, and the three pills fill the bottom row edge to edge with little margin.
